gaps.explanation: Statement (Exhibit H, trimmed p6, report p11) prints Total operating disbursements/depreciation 24,862 (Water 21,500 incl. Depreciation 4,166; Sewer 3,362). Detail holds Schedule 3 budgetary-cash-basis disbursements (trimmed p10, report p26): Water 62,940 + Sewer 3,362 = 66,302. Sewer agrees (3,362). Water budgetary 62,940 = payments for supplies & services 17,334 + purchase of capital assets 45,606 (Exhibit I, trimmed p7); Exhibit H Water 21,500 = 17,334 + depreciation 4,166. Gap 66,302 - 24,862 = 41,440 = capital purchases 45,606 - depreciation 4,166. Both printed totals are correct on their own basis; no detail fix.
